items.title: Transcriptome-wide off-target RNA editing induced by CRISPR-guided DNA base editors
items.abstract_start: CRISPR-Cas base-editor technology enables targeted nucleotide alterations, and is being increasingly used for research and potential therapeutic applications 1,2 . The most widely used cytosine base editors (CBEs) induce deamination of DNA cytosines using the rat APOBEC1 enzyme, which is targeted by a linked Cas protein-guide RNA complex 3,4 .
